origin: Codex 0.142.5 request that names an output limit of its own (max_output_tokens 2000: derived from the capture by adding the field): the relay is held to it, stops an answer with finish_reason length after some text and reports 32000 tokens, the usage is clamped to the limit, and the client is told the response is incomplete because its own limit was reached. The relay answers are authored from the documented Chat Completions shapes; the expected files are what the gateway does with them.
